tools.name: beamer_list_posts
tools.description: List changelog posts (announcements) with their translations, category, publish date, and stats (views, unique views, clicks, feedbacks, reactions). Does not record views. Beamer API: GET /posts.

tools.name: beamer_count_posts
tools.description: Count changelog posts that match the filters. Beamer API: GET /posts/count.

tools.name: beamer_get_post
tools.description: Get one changelog post by id: translations, category, dates, audience filter, and stats. Does not record a view. Beamer API: GET /posts/{postId}.

tools.name: beamer_list_post_comments
tools.description: List the comments that users left on one changelog post, with the author and text. Beamer API: GET /posts/{postId}/comments.

tools.name: beamer_count_post_comments
tools.description: Count the comments on one changelog post. Beamer API: GET /posts/{postId}/comments/count.

tools.name: beamer_list_post_reactions
tools.description: List the reactions (positive, neutral, negative) that users gave one changelog post. Beamer API: GET /posts/{postId}/reactions.

tools.name: beamer_count_post_reactions
tools.description: Count the reactions on one changelog post. Beamer API: GET /posts/{postId}/reactions/count.

tools.name: beamer_list_feature_requests
tools.description: List feature requests (ideas) from the Beamer Feedback board with status, category, vote and comment counts, and the author. Beamer API: GET /requests (beta).

tools.name: beamer_count_feature_requests
tools.description: Count feature requests that match the filters. Beamer API: GET /requests/count.

tools.name: beamer_get_feature_request
tools.description: Get one feature request by id. Beamer API: GET /requests/{featureRequestId}.

tools.name: beamer_list_feature_request_comments
tools.description: List the comments on one feature request, with the author and whether a team member wrote it. Beamer API: GET /requests/{featureRequestId}/comments.

tools.name: beamer_list_feature_request_votes
tools.description: List the votes on one feature request, with the user who voted and the date. Beamer API: GET /requests/{featureRequestId}/votes.

tools.name: beamer_list_nps_responses
tools.description: List Net Promoter Score responses with score (0-10), written feedback, user, and date. Beamer API: GET /nps.

tools.name: beamer_count_nps_responses
tools.description: Count NPS responses that match the filters. Beamer API: GET /nps/count.

tools.name: beamer_list_users
tools.description: List the end users that Beamer tracked in Analytics (first seen, last seen, language, custom attributes). Beamer API: GET /users.

tools.name: beamer_get_unread_count
tools.description: Get how many changelog posts are unread in the feed, plus the feed URL and the popup URL. Beamer API: GET /unread/count.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: beamer_list_posts, beamer_count_posts, beamer_get_post, beamer_list_post_comments, beamer_count_post_comments, beamer_list_post_reactions, beamer_count_post_reactions, beamer_list_feature_requests, beamer_list_feature_request_comments, beamer_get_unread_count · Private data: beamer_list_posts, beamer_get_post · Public sink: beamer_list_posts, beamer_get_post, beamer_list_post_comments, beamer_count_post_comments, beamer_list_post_reactions, beamer_count_post_reactions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: beamer_list_posts, beamer_count_posts, beamer_get_post, beamer_list_post_comments, beamer_count_post_comments, beamer_list_post_reactions, beamer_count_post_reactions, beamer_list_feature_requests, beamer_list_feature_request_comments, beamer_get_unread_count · Private data: beamer_list_posts, beamer_get_post · Public sink: beamer_list_posts, beamer_get_post, beamer_list_post_comments, beamer_count_post_comments, beamer_list_post_reactions, beamer_count_post_reactions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
